notes.title: Cardnarok: Raid with Gods Retail Version 1.1.0.a
notes.content:
Card Drop Adjustments
-Elite enemies will now drop some of the "rarer" cards after the battle.
Developer Notes:
Players still need to buy the cards in the Shop to unlock them first before they start dropping after battles.

Monster adjustment
-Chomper has been enlarged in battle.  It's an elite monster, after all.
Develop Notes:
No, its damage and health remain the same.  Don't worry about it.

Bug Fixes
-Some players have trouble starting new expeditions after the previous update.  The issue should be resolved.
-The Sealed effects were not working correctly in harder difficulties.  This is now fixed.

notes.title: Cardnarok: Raid with Gods Retail Version 1.1.0
notes.content:
New Monsters Added!
We have added seven new monsters to the game.
-Evil Eye
-Mimic
-Chomper
-Ghost
-Orc Soldier
-Orc Shaman
-Orc General
Developer Notes:
We agreed that the monster variations could use some upgrade and made it our priority.

Additional Monster Traits added
-8 new monster traits have been added to the game.
Developer Notes:
These new monsters are extremely dangerous.  Please be mentally prepared.

Trait Icons Optimized
The following icons have been updated to make on-death traits more recognizable.
-Trait: Discard on Death
-Trait: Explode on Death

Healer Changes
-Healers will now gain Special Treatment much earlier, at level 17.  Special Treatment: There is a 50% chance that a Special card will return to your hand after it's played.
Developer Notes:
We want to ensure that it is still viable to use Healers in battle after adding many healing cards in the earlier patches.

Difficulty Adjustments
-Monsters in Normal and Veteran difficulties now have one trait each.
-Hard, Nightmare, and Hell monsters have their traits increased by 1, respectively.
Developer Notes:
We want to make sure that the Normal and Veteran difficulties still require some thinking.

Card Changes
-Endure Pain now reduces the damage taken to 15% of the max HP, up from 10%.
-Shield Wall now reduces damage taken by 50%, down from 90%.
Developer Notes:
We designed these two cards to be lifesavers, not exploitable cards that enable unlimited switching.

More Card Changes
-Life Drain will now drain 20% of the damage dealt, down from 30%
-Playing a Recycled Crusading Strike will now draw an available Attack Card instead of restoring health.
-Playing a Recycled Offensive Maneuvers will now restore 3 Divine Points instead of restoring all Divine Points.
Developer Notes:
We have found out that life-draining cards have been used to replace healers, which is unintended.

New Achievements
-Steam Achievements for defeating Chomper (elite) and Orc General (Boss) have been added.

Bug Fix
--Damage Reduction cards did not work on Trait: Explode on Death if a movement skill kills the monster.  It has been fixed.

notes.title: Cardnarok: Raid with Gods Retail Version 1.0.2
notes.content:
Game Optimizations
The following optimizations are based on community feedback.
-Added a scroll bar at the Expedition Map for scrolling convenience.
-The cards in the Expedition Deck are now grouped by type, so players should have an easier time counting the number of specific cards.
-The two sides of the screen in deck-viewing UI will now respond to mouse-scrolling while viewing the deck.  This change should make the navigation through the Expedition Deck, the Draw Pile, and the Discard Pile easier.
-Azathoth will now move faster if you turn on "Faster Adventure Map animations" in the Options menu.

Bonus Abilities Cost Changes
-The cost for Combat Gold has been lowered from 20/60/120/200 to 20/45/75/110.
-The cost for Artifact Slots has been lowered from 20/60/120/200/300 to 20/45/75/110/150.
-The cost for Draw per Turn and Divine Point per Turn has been lowered from 50/120 to 30/70.
-The cost for Shop Refresh and Card Removal has been from 30/60/90 to 20/45/75.
-The cost for Opportunity Chance has been lowered from 30/60/90/120/150 to 20/45/75/110/150.
-The cost for the following Bonus Abilities have been lowered from 30/60/90/120 to 20/45/75/110:
Max HP
AP
SP
Monster Normal Damage
Monster HP
Opportunity Damage
Developer Notes:
We don't want players to spend too much time grinding for Bonus Points.  We want you to enjoy the game more.

Card Text Clarifications
-The tooltip for Fall Back now shows, "When this card is played, switch position with a random teammate.  Won't trigger Opportunity Attack."
Developer Notes:
This change is to clarify that the switch target from Fall Back is randomly chosen.

-Freezing Blast now shows "Deal direct SP damage to target enemy.  There is a 50% chance to inflict Frozen if the target is non-elite, lasting 1 turn.  Deal 50% extra damage if the target is already Frozen."
Developer Notes:
This change is to clarify since Bosses and Elites will never be inflicted by the Frozen ailment.

-Devour now reads, "Devour another random card in your hand and put it in the Discard Pile, then deal direct damage equal to AP*3 to target enemy."
Developer Notes:
No, the devoured card will not disappear from your deck.

Card Changes
-The casting cost for Shield Break has been increased from 2 to 3.  The casting cost for Impale stays the same.
Developer Notes:
Penetrate is extremely powerful against monsters with Physical Resistance traits in Hard Difficulty or above.  We have decided to increase the cost for Shield Break since it also removes Shield Points from the monsters.

Bug Fixes
-The game should remember the screen resolution options now.
-There were some issues with "Waking up from Nightmare" and "Hell Conquered" achievements.  They should be fixed now.
-The Burning effect from Fireball lasts 1 round but incorrectly showed 2 rounds.   It is now fixed.
-The level 1 version of Ra's Divine Card in the Deity Info panel said, "Gain health equal to 50% of the damage," while the actual percentage should be 30%.  The description has been updated.
-The number of cards shown on the Expedition Map was not updated when players redraw a new deck.  This is now fixed.

Known Issues
-Damage Reduction cards do not work on Trait: Explode on Death if a movement skill kills the monster. We're still looking into this.

notes.title: Cardnarok: Raid with Gods Retail Version 1.0.1
notes.content:
Expedition Map Optimization
-Optimized the node-generation algorithm in the Expedition Map.
Developer Notes:
Multiple camps or shops in a row should be eliminated.  Existing Expeditions are not affected.

Shop Items Added
-You can now purchase Chaos Orbs and Dice from Hephaestus.
Developer Notes:
This change should make leveling up Artifacts and Player Levels easier.

Compendium Change
-You can now view cards you have not acquired yet in Card Collections.
Developer Notes:
Some of our community players suggested that it is beneficial to be able to study the cards first.

Bug Fixes
-Cards that currently bypass the 10-card maximum should now be limited.  The limit should apply to card draws, card recycles, and curse cards.
-The text description on Energy Compression buff was incorrect.  It is now fixed.
-Artifact-related Steam Achievements for players who had already acquired all artifacts before the previous patch applied should be able to receive their achievements the next time they load a game.
-Fixed a bug where some players were having issues when starting new Expeditions.
Developer Notes:
We have received reports that some players were having issues starting new Expeditions after they uninstalled pirated copies and purchased official copies to support us.  We have made some changes in this patch to make it work, but please beware - we do not know what they did to our codes or your computer.

Known Issues
-Some players are encountering issues keeping their preferred screen resolution after rebooting the game.  We're working on a fix.
-Damage Reduction cards do not work on Trait: Explode on Death.  We're looking into this.

notes.title: Cardnarok: Raid with Gods Early Access Version 0.9.1
notes.content:
Nightmare Difficulty now live!
You can now play New Game+ in Nightmare Difficulty if you have conquered Hard in a previous run.
Developer Notes:
It is highly recommended that you have some high-level artifacts available and activate Bonus Abilities before trying.

Tips section added
-You can now view hints and tips by clicking on the corresponding icon at the top right corner.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37419662/22a0d7c93f00c91db25f8ad66464df2ee216f96d.jpg

Game Optimizations
-The general movement speed on the Adventure Map has been increased slightly.
-There is now a pop-up reminder letting players know if they forget to equip their artifacts.
-The treasure chests at the Altar no longer have randomized items.  Players can now mouse over the treasure chests to decide which one they want to get.
-Gold Coins required to keep the previous Expedition Deck has been decreased from 80% to 70%.
-Chaos Orbs will start dropping after regular battles on Hard or above difficulties to speed up artifact leveling.
-The damage from Traits Spell Reflection and Thorns has been lowered.
-Strategize will now appear slightly more often in the shop.

Card Changes
-One Step Ahead will now provide 2 temporary Divine Points instead of 1.
-The cost of Desperate Measures has been decreased from 3 to 2, and the damage modifier increased from SP*0.5 to SP*0.7 per card.

More Options
-Added an option to enable faster Adventure Map animations in the Preferences tab.
-Added an option to Skip Intro in the Preferences tab.
-Added an option to play cards without a target with one click in the Preferences tab.
-Added an option to toggle between Windowed, Borderless, and Exclusive Fullscreen in the Graphics tab.
Developer Notes:
Our community players suggest these options, and we have happily complied.

Bug Fix
-Fixed a bug where using cards with Fall Back can cause the combat to freeze on some occasions.
-The Opportunity Attack Chance shown at the top right panel of the combat UI will now change based on equipped artifacts and activated Bonus Abilities correctly.
-Fire Fist was showing incorrect Burning Damage in combat.  The damage number should be displayed correctly now.

notes.title: Cardnarok: Raid with Gods Early Access Version 0.9.0
notes.content:
Hard Difficulty now live!
To make sure the build is stable, we have decided to release only Hard Difficulty even though we have completed Nightmare and Hell Difficulties.  The latter two will be released shortly.
Developer Notes:
We have spent a lot of time testing, balancing, and fixing bugs since we have added many contents in this update.  Thank you for your patience!

Monster Passives: Traits
-Starting from Hard, monsters will possess one trait.  Nightmare monsters will have two, while Hell monsters will have three.
Developer Notes:
While introducing Traits, we want to remind players that deities placed in Reserves during Expeditions are no longer irrelevant.  For example, a Physical Damage Dealer is recommended when you preview a level where the monsters are resistant to SP damage.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37419662/7a01e82654aff3d200f05d5b6eaea156d62d6342.jpg
*Monsters can be countered by studying their Traits at the Battle Preview screen.

More New Cards!
-We have added 23 brand new cards in this update.
-Reminiscence
-Fire Fist
-Divine Anthem
-Nature's Ballad
-Cycle
-Dispel
-Power Dispel
-Mass Dispel
-Ultimate Dispel
-Crusading Strike
-Cunning Ploy
-Offensive Maneuvers
-Warrior's Gambit
-Strategize
-Rewind
-Flame Arrow
-Detonate
-Resurrection
-Power Cleanse
-Stabilize
-Elixir
-Scroll of Divinity
-Potion of Speed
Developer Notes:
These new cards, along with the new Traits from monsters, will generate more fun playstyles. We are confident that the tempo of the combat in Hard Difficulty or above is like a new game now.  We hope you like the new challenge!

Bonus Abilities Changes
-The effects of Combat EXP Dust increased from 5/10/15/20% to 25/50/75/100%
-The effects of Bonus Points increased from 25/50/75/100% to 50/100/150/200%
-The costs of Artifact Slots decreased from 100/200/300/400/500 to 30/60/120/200/300
-The costs of Draw per Turn decreased from 200/500 to 50/120
-The costs of Divine Point per Turn decreased from 200/500 to 50/120
-The costs of Shop Refresh from 30/80/150 to 30/60/90
-The costs of Opportunity Chance decreased from 30/100/200/400/600 to 30/60/90/120/150
-The costs of the following Bonus Abilities decreased from 30/100/200/400 to 30/60/90/120:
Max HP
AP
SP
Monster Normal Damage
Monster HP
Opportunity Damage
Developer Notes:
We hope to ease the grinding time required to tackle the harder difficulties.

Card Changes
Fireball: Burning effect added
Freezing Blast: Extra damage dealt to Frozen targets increased from 30% to 50%
Lacerate: Extra damage dealt to Bleeding targets increased from 30% to 50%
Envenom: Extra damage dealt to Poisoned targets increased from 30% to 50%
Anticipate: The Augment damage increased from 10% to 20% each time it is played
Arcane Strike: The Augment damage increased from 10% to 20% each time it is played
Developer Notes:
We want to encourage the use of card combos by increasing their overall damage.

Deity Changes
Ra
-True Grit I~II: Chance to trigger health restore increased from 50/70% to 60/75%

Monster Ability Changes
-Power Heal will now heal only 20%, down from 30%
-Distract will now lower damage caused by 20% instead of increasing Divine Points costs for other cards

Essence of Gods
-Added 50 Essence of Gods for new games
Developer Notes:
We want to let players get unlocked deity sooner.

Other UI Changes
-The icons of Electrocute and Paralyzed have been swapped

Other Optimizations
-Added some sound effects
-Added some special effects
-The page-turning animation has been simplified

Achievements
-Steam Achievements for completing Hard Difficulty and above have been added

notes.title: Cardnarok: Raid with Gods Early Access Version 0.8.0
notes.content:
Hello dear players!  We're happy to announce some important new features and changes in this major update.

Brand new Battle Preview and Expedition Map scrolling unlocked!
-You can now preview all monsters and their abilities in each battle node at the beginning of every Expedition to determine which route you want to take.
Developer Notes:
We have decided to open up the Expedition Map scrolling now that the Battle Preview feature is complete.  Players may now preview the monsters in every battle node, including their abilities and traits.  This feature is handy, if not essential, in the upcoming harder difficulties.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37419662/5216d3e64503dd3d93e8f0c480b969792a69a595.jpg

Keeping Expedition Decks
-Players get to keep their Expedition Decks starting from the second Expedition! This applies to new playthroughs only.
Developer Notes:
A lot of players have asked for this, and we have answered.  Oh, keeping the deck will cost a large portion of the gold, but we believe it's reasonable under the consideration that by keeping the deck, the need to buy cards or remove cards will be much less.  We will keep a close eye on it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37419662/71ebfebc95b6e2be19f98846c6601a3f0b0b1f50.jpg

Endless Mode Removed
-The Endless Mode button has been removed from the Main Menu.
Developer Notes:
We planned to develop an Endless Mode because players asked for a mode where they get to keep their decks instead of starting with a new deck every Expedition.  We believe that the new feature that gives players the option to keep their decks has achieved the same effect.  Removing the Endless Mode development will allow us to concentrate on the new difficulties and new monster abilities.

New Monsters have joined the battle!
-Earth Elemental
-Skeleton Soldier
-Skeleton Mage
-Skeleton General (Elite)
-Minotaur King (Boss)
-The descriptions of the original Minotaur (Elite) has been changed to the elite guards of the Minotaur King

Battle Scenes added
-6 new battle scenes have been added to the game

First Expedition length shortened
-The length of the first expedition has been cut short.
Developer Notes:
We have found out that the length of the first Expedition is too long for new players.
It's now shortened to let new players finish the first Expedition more quickly.

Routes added
-More routes have been added to Expeditions (other than the first one) to generate more options for the players.

Main Menu page updated
-As you have probably noticed, we have changed our logo.
Developer Notes:
This is the logo that we have finalized before the official launch.  We hope that you like it.

Monster Skills modified
-The Fire Breath from Cerberus will now inflict Burning.  A Burning character will take extra damage when attacked.
-Vampiric Touch: the health restored from the attack has been increased to 5 times the damage dealt.
-Vampiric Bite: the health restored from the attack has been increased to 5 times the damage dealt.
Developer Notes:
The health restored from these vampiric attacks has been close to irrelevant.  After the monsters sent their representatives to talk with us, we have agreed to increase the health restored.

Lowered Athena Unlock Requirement
-The condition to unlock Athena has been lowered to Zeus dealing 5k total damage, down from 100k.
Developer Notes:
After several players talked to us about this, we have agreed that it would be better if we let players unlock their 4th character - and the 1st Physical Damage Dealer - much earlier in the game.

Card Modifications
-Curse Cards will now vanish instead of going to the Discard Pile after they are played.  We have decided to ignore the protest from the slimes.
-First Aid: the Divine Point costs to play this card has been reduced from 2 to 1.

UI Optimization
-After acquiring items on the Adventure Map, the message will stay longer and more visible now.
-All card types have received a tooltip, including Attack Cards, Spell Cards, Divine Cards, Resource Cards, Special Cards, and Curse Cards.

Tutorial Optimization
-Deleted and tweaked some Expedition tutorial content
-Deleted and tweaked some Battle Tutorial content
Developer Notes:
We have removed the corresponding tutorials now that players can now move the deities' battle positions in the Battle Preview.  Some Battle Tutorial texts have also been deleted since we have added tooltips to the cards and locked ineffective cards for new players.

Bug Fix
-Fixed a damage number display bug when Shield Wall and Side Step took effect simultaneously.
-Fixed a text issue with Aphrodite.
-Fixed a bug where the producer implemented the wrong card texts for Holy Hymn and Regenerate.

notes.title: Cardnarok: Raid with Gods Early Access Version 0.7.4
notes.content:
The Bonus Abilities feature now live!
-You may now spend Bonus Points gained from previous playthroughs in New Game+!
-The activated Bonus Abilities can be viewed at the top right corner.
Developer Notes: This feature is designed for harder difficulties.  However, if you want to have an easier time with the Normal difficulty or below, feel free to utilize this new feature!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37419662/10ef3dad27994c5c5b5352f47ead6067fdb83998.jpg

Opportunity Attack Chance now visible
-Based on Community Player requests, you can now view the Opportunity Attack chance!
Developer Notes: By moving the mouse cursor to the top right corner, there is an icon that shows the currently activated Bonus Abilities, in addition to the current Opportunity Attack Chance (modified by Difficulty modifiers, Artifacts, and activated Bonus Abilities).

Monster Damage Renamed
-Monster Damage has been renamed to Normal Damage.  Affected displays include Monster Intention Info in battle, Artifact Equipment Info, and Monsters Info in the Compendium.
Developer Notes: This change is to make monster skill and artifact descriptions more precise.

UX Optimization
-Based on community feedback, the Battle Summary screen will now use mouse left-clicking instead of right-clicking to proceed.

Misc Optimization
-Added a tooltip on the Adventure Map to clarify the number of Expeditions left.

Changes on Artifacts
- Ankh of Life Lv 3~5: decreases Monster Damage by 5%/10%/15% has been changed to decreases the Normal Damage from all enemies by 3%/6%/10%
- Hippolyte's Belt Lv 3~5: decreases Monster Damage by 5%/10%/15% has been changed to decreases the Normal Damage from all enemies by 3%/6%/10%
Developer Notes: We have found out that, after equipping max-level Ankh of Life, Hippolyte's Belt, and Aegis, the stacked effects are game-breaking.

Changes on the Traveling Merchant 
-Merchandise refresh is now limited to 3 times per encounter.  Bonus Abilities can raise the cap.
-Card removal is now limited to 3 times per encounter.  Bonus Abilities can raise the cap.

notes.title: Cardnarok: Raid with Gods Developer Log #1
notes.content:
It's been six full months since we went into Early Access on May 26th.

This is the first time we publish a title on Steam and the first time we sell a game AND develop it simultaneously.  We have made 34 updates since our Early Access launch, averaging 5.6 updates per month.

Let us start by giving a summary of our major updates in the past 6 months.

5/26 – Early Access Launch with new cards and monsters (compared to the amount in Beta)
5/29 – Added "Ineffective Card Notification"
6/2 – Adjusted monster level growth to ease the difficulty curve
6/6 – Improved buff/debuff visual effects
6/9 – Can forfeit card selection after battles and acquire gold instead
6/12 – Added merchant tutorial, and revamped battle victory UI for a faster flow
6/20 – Added 5 new cards and adjusted deity abilities
6/24 – Added Monster Info/Intention panel
7/4 – Added Expedition Summary screen
7/13 – Added Campaign Progression Panel
7/15 – Deity Info now sorted by levels, and optimized debuff trigger notifications
7/20 – Added 6 new cards
7/21 – Added more detailed information for the save files
7/30 – Added new battle music and auto-save notifications
8/6 – Added Loading screen transition, remade the End Turn button
8/20 – Re-distributed deity ability growth to give more distinct differences amongst the same deity types
8/30 – Added Chaos Orbs, so players can start saving them for the future Artifact Upgrades.  Also added the ability to view the Draw Pile and the Discard Pile
9/3 – Added Campaign Summary
9/9 – Added tooltips for cards
9/17 – Added selections for the Altar
9/23 – Added Difficulty Selection screen, in addition to Very Easy and Easy Mode
10/5 – Added 48 Steam Achievements
10/27 – Added the Compendium, with Deity and Card unlocks
10/30 – Added Artifact and Monster unlocks in the Compendium

While the team is proud of the footprints we have made above, we have also learned quite a few things in the past 6 months.

1.	We thought that if we focus on improving the game features and its quality, the sales numbers will go up automatically.  Yep, that was way too naive.  Focusing on development and lacking proper marketing, the exposure will only go into a downward spiral.  We have learned the hard way that this is no longer an "improve a game, and it will automatically sell better" era.  Publishers, advertisers, streamers, and platform algorithms have a bigger impact on the sales numbers than the core gameplay.
2.	During Early Access, wishlist numbers go up, but the actual sales numbers do not go up proportionally.
3.	We have also found out that players actually delete wishlists, especially during major seasonal sales.  Darn.
4.	We have fixed most issues mentioned in the negative reviews in a matter of hours or days.  But the negative reviews will be there to stay - potentially misleading new players to believe that the issues still exist and there's not much we can do about it.
5.	Based on our data, some players have played more than 20 or even 30 hours.  But the ratio of these hardcore players recommending our game is actually very low.
6.	The reaction of new players is very direct and quick - if they think the game is too hard, they immediately refund the game.  If they encounter a bug, they immediately refund the game.  Every time we update a new patch, we get really nervous and refresh the sales page every few hours to see the refund data or the message boards to see any bugs that we didn't find out during our testing.
7.	We also found out that we could not make everyone happy - some think our game is too easy, while some think it is too hard.  Some appreciate our cartoonish art style, while some think it looks like it's made for children.
8.	Our foolproof mechanisms were nowhere near ready when we first launched the game into Early Access 6 months ago.  We have seen streamers using all kinds of wrong ways to play the game - for example, using Ares to play Chain Lightning.  Then they criticized our design based on that result (the damage numbers are too low and the game is too tedious).  Some of them even believed that switching Zeus back and forth to repeatedly gain "Leading the Charge" buff was a bug, while it was actually an intended design.   We have spent at least a third of our time since the EA launch trying to plug the holes that might have caused players to misunderstand the intended gameplay design.
9.	We have also underestimated the "education cost" for gameplay that is actually attempting to be innovative.  Some players suggested that our game "should have done this or that as other roguelite deckbuilders do."
10.	We have also learned that, based on social media comments, even though we are making this game with only 3 devs, many players would still compare our game content/features with similar games made by teams 4-6 times our size.  We have to admit that the lack of development staff is no longer a valid reason to make players more forgiving to us - that is, if we want to ship a game, we need to be ready to survive against games made by many more developers.

It may sound like just another familiar story that an indie dev team is trying to survive against all odds, but we have poured our heart and soul into this game, and we hope more players would get to know the fun of the gameplay.  We will do our best to complete the base game and end EA early next year.

Our next targets, before the game's full launch, are to complete the following content.
-Artifact Upgrades (it's almost complete and under testing)
-Bonus Points (where you can spend at the beginning of New Game+ to power up the playthrough)
-Hard, Nightmare, and Hell Mode (new monster abilities and card counters)

While we're at it, here's a sneak preview of the upcoming Artifact Upgrade (with revamped Artifact Equipment UI).  Basically, we have re-done the whole Artifacts framework for this one.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37419662/12fec0b4a0081bdb865c723104b57f23af6edc26.jpg

We will also make the free Chinese Myth DLC available as soon as we can.  The artwork for the Chinese Myth is almost complete.  However, the abilities of Chinese Deities, Monsters, and Artifacts still require more time to implement.  Our only programmer on the team is already working around the clock, and we really need him to stay healthy to complete the game.

That's about it, our Devlog #1.  We want to share with our community where we stand right now and where we are heading.  If you approve of our hard work, please share, leave a review, or simply say something nice.  Thank you all!

notes.title: Cardnarok: Raid with Gods Early Access Version 0.7.0
notes.content:
New Features now available!

The Compendium has arrived!!  You can now see the following items in the Compendium: Deities and Cards.

Deities - All available deities in-game are now listed in the compendium.  You can also view the unlock conditions of each locked deity here.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37419662/5c434cdd9acebde4a6dd4312e2b25f937f135b51.png

Cards - All obtainable cards are also listed in the compendium.  After you obtain them in the game, they will be unlocked and available for the starting decks of future expeditions.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37419662/8db133307e36ebfb38e7098e024d26a6077c48c6.png

Developer Notes: Tabs for Monsters and Artifacts will be available shortly in the Compendium.  New cards and deities will also be added as we develop the game.

Select Starting Team feature is now implemented!
Developer Notes: This is the #1 feature our community has been asking for.  You can now select any deity unlocked in previous playthroughs!  The unlock conditions and progress for locked deities can be viewed if you mouse-over their locks.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37419662/c6a39a068f3013e9a8452384ec611b2bd3d74646.png

Major Card Unlock mechanism changes:
- To make sure card unlock is methodical, only unlocked cards will be available in starting decks and after battles.  The Traveling Merchant will have a chance to sell cards currently not in the Compendium, and purchasing them will unlock them in your collection.

Changes to minimum cards
- The minimum cards required in an Expedition deck has been changed to 20.
Developer Note: We know that some players put only 10 resource cards in the deck and exploit the Lightning Rod ability of Zeus.  We don't want to nerf Lightning Rod, so this change was necessary as It really took the challenge and fun out of the game.

Improvements
- New cards not yet collected in the Compendium will now have a New! tag at the Merchant.
- We have added a V-Sync option at the Options menu.  It should improve the CPU usage and framerate in most cases.  If it's causing issues on your computer, please switch it off.

Bug Fix
- Fixed some typos in the tutorial.  Thanks to our community players for pointing them out.
- Tooltip delay from artifact selection and post-battle screens have been fixed.

notes.title: Cardnarok: Raid with Gods Early Access Version 0.6.25
notes.content:
40+ Steam Achievements are now available!
Developer Notes: While we are still working on Unlockables and Collection features, we have discovered that the unlockable conditions and achievements go hand in hand, and achievements can be ready sooner.  So here we go and have fun!

Bug Fix
- Fall Back can cause some issues when there is only one character left standing.  This issue has been fixed.

notes.title: Cardnarok: Raid with Gods Early Access Version 0.6.24
notes.content:
Difficulty Selection – Easy and Very Easy Mode now ready!
Developer Notes: Many players have told us that the game is too difficult.  In this patch, we have finally implemented Very Easy and Easy Mode with the new Difficulty Selection feature.  As for Hard Mode and beyond, we will need more time to add new buffs and adjust AI for monsters, as well as the Artifact Upgrade feature, which is required to tackle higher difficulty tiers.  Thank you for your support and patience!

Altar Changes
- Giving up the selection of deities or treasure chests will now give 15 Essence of Gods, up from 10.
- Increase the chance that deities will appear in the altar, while the chance for treasure chests decreased.
Developer Notes: We are still making tweaks so players will have a higher chance of getting the deity they like at the altar.

Game Optimization
- Dark Corruption: Card text modified to clarify the damage trigger timing.
- The Final Boss now moves faster on the Adventure Map.
Developer Notes: We have sped up the chasing speed of the final boss, effectively reducing the number of Expeditions required to complete one playthrough.

UI Optimization
- Save game difficulty has been added to the save file UI, with minor adjustments to the layout.

Bug Fix
- Various minor bug fix

notes.title: Cardnarok: Raid with Gods Early Access Version 0.6.23
notes.content:
Major Revamp for the Altar!
- Instead of a new random deity appearing every few laps when passing by the altar on the adventure map, there will now be three options to choose from, including deities and rare, valuable items.  Players can now choose their rewards based on their preference, provided that they have enough Essence of Gods.  Like choosing card rewards after battles, skipping all three options will provide some Essence of Gods instead.

Treasure Chests Changes
- Treasure Chests no longer contain Gold Coins or Experience Dust.  This change is to increase the chance that players can acquire the Essence of Gods in the treasure chests.  Gold coins and experience dust can still be obtained on Event Tiles, Resource Tiles, or after winning a battle.

New Events
- New events have been added to the Adventure Map and the Expedition Map with new rewards, including the Essence of Gods.

Font Change for the English Version
Developer Notes: Our community players have told us that the font we have previously used has made reading texts difficult.  After experimenting with dozens of fonts, we have chosen a new one.  We hope that you will like it.

Card Changes
- Cleanse: In addition to the original power to remove all negative effects from a friendly target, it has also gained the Swift effect, drawing another card when it is played.
Developer Notes: We have noticed that players are less willing to put this card into their deck, mainly because it can be useless if there is no debuff to remove.  We have added to it the ability to draw another card, so you can choose to play it when you find yourself in dire need to draw another card.  Hopefully, this will increase the usage of this card.

UI Optimization
- Minor adjustment to the God Info page to fix some truncation issues.
- Added tooltips on some icons to better explain them.

notes.title: Cardnarok: Raid with Gods Early Access Version 0.6.22
notes.content:
Card Tooltips Implemented!
- You can now see card tooltips when you move the mouse cursor over cards with special abilities.
Developer Notes: We wanted to make card texts and the UI simple at first.  However, after community players suggested and some internal debates, we have agreed that other games in the same genre do this for a reason.  After spending weeks working through the data, we finally have this feature ready.

Special Abilities Revamped
Developer Note: We have integrated special card abilities.  Please take a look at the examples below.
- Penetrate: Ignore enemy shield or other defenses
- Augment: Every time a card with the same name is played, the damage is increased by 10%
- Swift: When this card is played, draw a card
- Fall Back: When this card is played, move back to the back row.  Won't trigger Opportunity Attack or Counterattack

Debuff Info
Developer Note: While we were at it, we have also made tooltips for debuffs available.  Here are some examples.
- Bleeding: Inflict damage when taking any action.
- Poisoned: Inflict damage at the end of turn.

Bleeding Effect Mechanic Change
- When a monster inflicted with Bleeding makes an Opportunity Attack, it will take damage from the Bleeding effect now.
Developer Note: This was the initial design.  We took Opportunity Attack out from Bleeding damage to avoid insane Bleeding decks from happening.   However, we have found out that this makes Bleeding and Poisoned effects not distinctive enough since all monsters only attack once per turn.  After careful considerations, we have decided to change the effect back.  We will keep monitoring the game balance after this change.

Card Changes
- Some cards have their descriptions modified and polished.
- All descriptions on "rounds" have been changed to "turns," for consistency.
- Bleed：The damage-over-time has decreased from AP*0.8 to AP*0.6.
Developer Note: This change is made due to the bleeding effect changes.  Though it may seem that the card is nerfed, the overall damage can be potentially much higher since monsters can take damage multiple times from bleeding each round now.

notes.title: Cardnarok: Raid with Gods Early Access Version 0.6.21
notes.content:
Campaign Summary is now ready!
- You can now see the result of each playthrough upon finishing up the campaign.

Lowered Expedition Requirement
-Based on our community feedback, we have reduced the number of Expeditions required to complete one playthrough from 10 to 8, speeding up the process.

Warning for outdated save files
-A warning text has been added when save files from the previous versions are detected.
Developer Note: We understand that having save files obsolete can be frustrating; therefore, we have decided to let players use save files from previous versions to continue playing.   However, please note that old save files may be missing some data from newly-added features.

We do need to keep updating and altering the game content and data in order to present the game at its best at the official launch, and we thank you for your understanding and support.  

Bug Fix
- Some card text display issues are fixed for the English version.

notes.title: Cardnarok: Raid with Gods Early Access Version 0.6.20
notes.content:
New Collectable Item: Chaos Orbs!
Chaos Orbs are very rare materials used to upgrade Artifacts, and only Elite and Boss monsters have a chance to drop them.  While the Artifact Upgrade feature is not yet ready, we want to give players a chance to start collecting these orbs first during their current playthroughs.  These orbs are shared among all save files and all future play modes.

New Feature:
- You can view cards in the Draw Pile and the Discard Pile during combat now!
Developer Notes: We agree that this is a useful feature that should have been done earlier.

Optimization:
- Petrified status inflicted by Medusa will now last through the enemy round and expire at the start of the player round.
Developer Notes: This will make tanking easier, as the petrified character will now maintain an 80% damage reduction during the enemy round.

notes.title: Cardnarok: Raid with Gods Early Access Version 0.6.19
notes.content:
Notes on the major balancing and data structure changes:
We have spent quite a few weeks on this update.  The New Game+ features and metagame data structure are more complicated than we originally anticipated.  Future features will share some data across multiple save files, and the original plug-in has been giving us a lot of trouble.  For example, the auto-save time was 10 times longer in our internal testing.  

After contacting the author of the plug-in and had no luck fixing the problems, our (only) engineer has decided to write his own save file data from scratch.  In addition to these changes, we have also made significant changes to the game balance and hopefully will improve the game for the launch later in the year.  Thank you for your patience and support!

Save Data Reset
- We must reset the save files due to the data structure changes to avoid crashes and fatal data errors.  We promise that it will not happen again after we get out of Early Access.

Attribute Changes on deities
Developer Note: We have adjusted the attributes of all deities.  For example, while both are Magical Damage Dealers, Zeus has a bit more HP than Isis while his Spell Power is slightly lower.  The attribute changes have already taken the abilities of the deities and usefulness of their Divine Cards into consideration.

- Tanks: Minor increase to their Attack Power.  Now they will be dealing a bit more damage with their Divine Cards.
- Physical Damage Dealers: Their HP increased by approximately 30%.  Compared to Magical Damage Dealers, they are more suitable to absorb damage at the frontline and take on the roles as part-time tanks.
- Magical Damage Dealers: This popular class remains mostly the same.
- Healers: Their HPs have been slightly increased.  They still cannot take multiple hits, though.
- Supporters: Slightly increased their Attack Power and Spell Power.  While still no match to pure damage dealers, they can deal significantly more damage than tanks.  Also, their HPs have been increased by approximately 20%.

Ability Changes on deities
- Ra
Ra’s switching ability Wings of Liberty has been changed to Power of the Sun: AP increased by 20% after moving to the front row until the next damage card is played (cannot be stacked).
Developer Note: Our community players have noted that Ra’s switching ability isn’t considered useful.  We have decided to increase his Attack Power when he moves to the front row, dealing more damage and increased the health gain, further improved his survivability.

- Isis
Holy Flare I~II: damage dealt to all enemies increased from 30/50% of her Spell Power to 40/60%.
Developer Note: Everybody says that Zeus is better than Isis.  Please give her another chance.

- Athena
Athena used to share the same switching ability Cunning Strike with Anubis, dealing damage to the enemy with the lowest HP ratio.  To further differentiate these two physical damage dealers, we have changed her ability to Spear of Valor: Deal AP damage to an enemy with the highest HP ratio when moving to the Front Row.  Since she cannot finish off low-health enemies as Anubis does with this new ability, the damage has been increased by 20%, making her more effective at weakening enemies.

- Anubis
Cunning Strike: renamed to Death Strike, with the same power and effects.

Other Notable Changes
- The chance that Anubis will gain a Resurrection Scroll on Empty Tiles has been increased to 100%.
Developer Note: We have decided to make this change because the chance to get on Empty Tiles itself is low enough.

- Based on Community feedback, Artifacts will now show the exact numbers of their effects.
Developer Note: We agree that players will have an easier time picking the artifacts with the numbers shown to them.  It’s also vital to show the numbers for the future Forge Artifact feature.

Bug Fix
- Isis and Athena’s card-returning Divine Card effects were having some un-clickable issues.  These issues have been fixed.
- Killing the last monster while the card returns to the hand would sometimes make the card stuck on the screen.  This issue, too, has been fixed.

notes.title: Cardnarok: Raid with Gods Early Access Version 0.6.18
notes.content:
UI/UX Optimization
- Improved UI for Expedition Deck, Expedition Summary, and Cards Removal.
Developer Note:
We have taken away all NEXT buttons, so players can now exit these screens by right-clicking the mouse button.  It should make the overall experience more consistent.

Bug Fix
- Fixed an issue where sometimes clicking on the deity does not respond correctly in the Adventure Map.

notes.title: Cardnarok: Raid with Gods Early Access Version 0.6.17
notes.content:
UI Optimization
- Added a transition when loading data.
- Added an info panel for friendly characters in combat.  Move the mouse cursor over your deities to see them.
Developer Note: We have discovered that many players have focused their attention on different Divine Cards provided by the deities while not utilizing their movement abilities.  We have added the panel so players can have access to this information and hopefully strategize the movement abilities accordingly.
- Revamped the End Turn button
Developer Note: Many players have pointed out that the animation of the End Turn button was not clear enough.  We have spent some time optimizing this button, and we hope you like it better.

Bug Fix
- The left head of Cerberus is hard to target and sometimes doesn't show its info correctly.  This issue has been fixed.

notes.title: Cardnarok: Raid with Gods Early Access Version 0.6.16a
notes.content:
Bug Fix
- Sometimes characters do not appear correctly before fighting the Final Boss.  This has been fixed.

notes.title: Cardnarok: Raid with Gods Early Access Version 0.6.16
notes.content:
Completing Endgame Scores, Unlockable Rewards, and Difficulty Tiers will be taking considerably longer than we originally anticipated due to the fundamental changes in the game's original campaign structure and the save game data structure.  Add to the fact that completing these features separately may break the current game loop.  We have decided to update small patches in the coming weeks to keep the ball rolling while integrating these planned new features into a major update.

New BGM
- Multiple new combat BGMs have been implemented to provide more variety.

Optimization
- We have added a message to notify players during auto-saving.

notes.title: Cardnarok: Raid with Gods Early Access Version 0.6.15
notes.content:
Optimization
- The display of save games has been optimized to show the date, location, and the number of Expeditions.  Please note that previous save files may display some info incorrectly, but the actual game progressions are not affected.  New games should not have this issue.
 - Fireball’s special effect has been tweaked, and its sound effect replaced by a new one.  The explosion should not sound broken anymore.

Bug Fixes
- Fixed an issue with the Final Boss battle scene.

notes.title: Cardnarok: Raid with Gods Early Access Version 0.6.14
notes.content:
New cards have arrived!  We have added 5 cards to your arsenal.  Hopefully, they will add more strategic depth to your deck!

New Attack Cards:
Hit and Run: Deal AP damage to target enemy, then move back to the back row.  Won't trigger Opportunity Attack.
Lacerate: Deal AP damage to target enemy. Causes an extra 20% damage to Bleeding targets

New Spell Cards:
Gracious Retreat: Deal SP damage to target enemy, then move back to the back row.  Won't trigger Opportunity Attack.
Poison: Deal SP damage to target enemy, then deal SP*0.8 Poison damage at the end of its round, lasting 2 rounds 

New Special Card:
First Aid: Heal 20% health for a friendly target, then move back to the back row.  Won't trigger Opportunity Attack.

Optimization
- We have spent some time to optimize how resources are loaded.  Combat should now become more smooth. 

Ability Changes on deities
- Zeus
Leading the Charge: SP increased by 40% after moving to the front row until the next damage card is played (cannot be stacked)
Developer Note: When making the new card “Poison”, we have found out that under the current structure, DOT (damage-over-time) will not enjoy the benefits from Leading the Charge.  We have changed his ability so that instead of a flat damage increase, his SP will increase in order to let the DOT damage enjoy its full effect.

Bug Fixes
-Power Overload and Energy Overflow will now correctly show 10% on the tooltips of their respective icons
-Fixed an issue where sometimes Power Overload and Energy Overflow didn't stack up correctly at the beginning of each round

notes.title: Cardnarok: Raid with Gods Early Access Version 0.6.13
notes.content:
Optimizations
- Optimized the Deity Info panel.  Switching between characters in the Deity Info Panel while viewing their Intro Story will no longer switch back to the Ability screen automatically.
- The order of the deities in the Deity Info panel is now sorted by levels.  
- Using Exp Dust will no longer snap back to the top of the order.  Hopefully, that will make managing your characters easier.
- Optimized the Item and Artifact panels.  Moving the mouse cursor over the artifacts and items will have a more visible effect now.
- Friendly characters having negative effects like Petrified, Rooted, Frozen, and Paralyzed triggered will now have more clear visuals.  New players were often confused about why their characters could not move (rooted) or could not act (petrified) because those effects were not visible enough.

notes.title: Cardnarok: Raid with Gods Early Access Version 0.6.12
notes.content:
New Feature
- Added a Campaign Progression board that will be available upon completing of the first Expedition.
Developer Note: Now that this feature is complete, we can move on to make the final game summary.  Please note that old save files will not show previous Expedition stats because the data was not recorded until this patch.  Players can still use old save files to complete their playthroughs.

Optimizations
- Optimized UX so players can now view the cards during attack animations.
- Game assets have been optimized for a smaller build and better resource allocation.

Bug Fixes 
- Sometimes the Monster Info panel will be stuck on the screen.  This bug has been fixed.

notes.title: Cardnarok: Raid with Gods Early Access Version 0.6.11
notes.content:
Warning!!  We have changed a lot of data in the recent patch, therefore old save files may be corrupted or may cause unexpected errors.  We strongly suggest that you start a new game with this patch.

New Feature
- Added an Expedition Summary screen at the end of Expeditions.
Developer Note: This is essential for the future Campaign Summary feature.  The scores will also be calculated and used in Difficulty Level Selection and Unlockable Rewards in the near future, therefore it is taking longer than we originally expected.  Please bear with us.

Optimizations
- The wait time upon using Life Drain, Desperate Measures, Do or Die, Power of the Dead, Arcane Strike, One Step Ahead, Sanction, Nimble Strike, Sun Strike, and Myriad of Magic has been decreased.
- Optimized the trigger time of several passive abilities
- Updated the description of Ares at the beginning of expeditions

Bug Fixes 
- Fixed a bug that caused Limit Break to provide less AP than intended
- Fixed a text error in Ares’ skill list
- Fixed an issue where Zeus might lose his Leading the Charge buff after playing a non-damage card
- Fixed a debuff text error when monsters are paralyzed
- Fixed an issue that caused players to remove multiple cards in the merchant card removal if they clicked too fast
- Sometimes using Oracle or Calculated Risk when the Draw Pile is empty can cause the combat to freeze up.  This issue should be fixed.

notes.title: Cardnarok: Raid with Gods Early Access Version 0.6.10a
notes.content:
Bug Fix
- Fix a bug where Limit Break will sometimes deal 0 damage.

notes.title: Cardnarok: Raid with Gods Early Access Version 0.6.10
notes.content:
This Friday’s regular update has arrived early due to the Dragon Boat Festival national holidays in Taiwan.  Happy Dragon Boat Festival to you all!

New Function
- Dragging a card to target a monster will now show the monster's information.  You can turn this function off at the Preferences menu. 

Monster changes 
- All slimes except the Gold ones have agreed to decrease the chance to play Curse Cards significantly.  Remember to kill Gold Slimes first when you see them. 
Developer Note: We have noticed that most players still have trouble dealing with the Curse Cards.  We have decided to make this change and restore the probabilities once the higher difficulty tiers are ready.

Ability changes on deities
- Ares
Shield of Judgment I~III: The Shield Points provided lowered from 15/20/25% to 15/17/20%
Readiness: The Shield Points provided have been changed from 10% of current HP to 10% of max HP.
Developer Note: We had received feedback from our community that the tanking ability of Ares decreased drastically when his remaining HP went low.  The original design was expecting players to put a shield on Ares at the start of each turn, generating a highly efficient shield for damage mitigation.  Upon the previous Shield of Judgment changes, we found out that we need to adjust Ares’ playstyle and increase his survivability at low health level.  We will keep a close eye on Ares over the next a few patches.

Optimizations
- The wait time upon using Anticipate, Bloodlust and Devour has been decreased 
- Optimized the number of monsters per level in Expeditions.
- The secondary targets of AoE spells will now enjoy the full effect from Leading the Charge.  Fireball, anyone?
- Shield will now absorb Poison damage

Bug Fix 
- Fix a bug where players quit the game following a defeat then load the save file that potentially causes the feather on the Expedition Map stop to respond.   We will try to deal with ragequit better in the future.

notes.title: Cardnarok: Raid with Gods Early Access Version 0.6.9
notes.content:
Fresh new cards!  We have added 2 new Attack Cards and 3 Special Cards, in addition to some tweaks to deities and cards.

New Attack Cards:
Limit Break: Deal AP Damage to target enemy and increase AP by 20%, lasting 1 round.
Shockwave: Deal AP damage to target enemy. Deal AP*0.7 damage to all other enemies.

New Special Cards:
Magic Shield: Creates a shield that absorbs damage equal to 20% of target's max HP, lasting 1 round.
Blessing of the World: Heal 30% health for all friendly deities
Shield Boom: Deal damage to an enemy equal to 5 times the friendly Shield Points total. This damage does not benefit from any other damage boosting sources.

Optimizations:
- The initial cost to refresh merchant inventory has been decreased.  Happy shopping!
- Level 5 deity skills can now be acquired at level 3.  We want players to enjoy them a bit sooner.
- The wait time upon using Bleed!, Shield Break, Weaken, Freezing Touch, Fireball and Heal have been reduced.
- We have also greatly sped up the animation time of Thunderbolt and Chained Lightning upon multiple enemies.

Ability changes on deities
- Ares
Divine Card: Defend has been changed to Shield of Judgment: Deal AP Damage to an enemy and provide Shield Points to Ares equal to 15% of his Max HP, lasts 1 round 
Developer Note: We have made this change after careful considerations because our community players and some critics pointed out that as the God of War, Ares’ Divine Cards should be able to deal damage.  In addition, Shield Points gained will not decrease based on his current health level, making him more resilient at low health.

- Hermes
Level 50 skill Premeditation II: Restore all Divine Points when the deck is shuffled has been changed to Lightning Reflex II: 80% chance to gain 1 Divine Point when attacked. 
Developer Note: This is to make infinite Lightning Rod combo less likely to appear.  The combo takes away all the fun.

Card Modifications
- Berserk Lash: the health cost has been decreased from AP*0.2 to AP*0.1.
- Rampage: Divine Point cost has been decreased from 3 to 2.
- Bloodlust: Damage has been decreased from AP*2 to AP*1.  It’s still a powerful card.
- Shield Wall: Divine Point cost has been decreased to 1.
- Endure Pain: The damage reduction has been improved to 10% of max HP, from 15%.
- Desperate Measures: Damage has been increased from SP*0.4 per card to SP*0.5 per card.

Bug Fix
- Various minor bug fixes

notes.title: Cardnarok: Raid with Gods Early Access Version 0.6.7
notes.content:
Optimization
-Skipping card selection after battles will provide some gold for compensation now.  Also added a skip button to speed up the level-up process based on player feedback.
-As our community suggested, we have added a button at the Altar to speed up the process.

Bug Fix
- Fix a bug where the game will freeze after combat tutorial ends on some PCs

notes.title: Cardnarok: Raid with Gods Early Access Version 0.6.6
notes.content:
UI Optimization
- Finetuned the display area of the floating texts to avoid truncation issues.

Bug Fix
- Fix a bug where the bleeding effect does not kill the enemies (or heroes!)
- Fix a bug where Do or die did not trigger low-health buffs properly.

notes.title: Cardnarok: Raid with Gods Early Access Version 0.6.5a
notes.content:
Bug Fix
- Fix a glitch that stops Minotaur from acting and freezes the game.

notes.title: Cardnarok: Raid with Gods Early Access Version 0.6.5
notes.content:
This is an important update as we have revamped how buffs and debuffs show up in combat, in addition to making various bug fixes and tweaks.

UI Revamp
- The buffs and debuffs will now be more visible as floating texts and icons when they are applied to characters in battle.
Developer Note: After watching how some streamers played on the internet, we have come to the realization that we have underestimated the importance of how we present the addition and removal of buffs and debuffs in combat.  In the past 3-4 days we have been working on a solution that hopefully can help players see more clearly when a new buff or debuff is applied to heroes or monsters.

Optimization
- The feather that says “LEAVE” will now have special effects when an expedition is over.
Developer Note: This is a temporary fix before we implement a proper ending screen for Expeditions.
- Added a restriction to healing cards.  You can no longer use a healing card on a defeated character unless you revive him/her first.

Ability Changes on deities
- Ra
Might of the War God has been changed to Divine Majesty: Deities from the same myth receive a 10% boost to their Max HP in battle. 
Developer Note: This is purely our fault.  Anubis already possess this ability for Egyptian deities.

Bug Fix
- Adrenaline will now trigger properly when entering battles at 20% or less health.
- Perseverance will now trigger properly when entering battles at 20% or less health.
- Extra Draw will now function properly for every turn.
- The altar will now stop playing extra sound effects when you click on it multiple times.

Known Issues
- Do or die does not trigger buffs that are supposed to be triggered at low health.  We will fix it soon.
- Some buffs are missing icons.  We'll add them as soon as we can.
- Some floating texts are truncated.  We are working on it.

notes.title: Cardnarok: Raid with Gods Early Access Version 0.6.4a
notes.content:
Bug Fix
- Fix a bug where some players encounter a glitch while fighting the Final Boss.

notes.title: Cardnarok: Raid with Gods Early Access Version 0.6.4
notes.content:
The community has spoken and we have listened!

Due to a high percentage of players demanding this feature, we have worked day and night to bring the Enemy Info panel (some call it Intentions) to the table!  On top of that, now you can do calculations on incoming damage before you make your decisions too!  We are hoping that this new feature will have a significant impact on the combat flow.

New Feature
- Enemy Info panel has been implemented in battle!  Hover your mouse cursor over the monsters to see them!
Developer Note: We're hoping this feature can make players consider their next moves by discerning their possible actions and calculating the incoming damage.  This should add another layer of strategical depth to the game.  Note that monster actions cannot be determined in the player's turn because their AI will adjust based on their health level AFTER players make their moves.

Difficulty Adjustment
- Monster levels have been tweaked to make the difficulty pacing easier to handle.
Developer Note: We have been told by our Community that the difficulty curve is too steep after finishing the first Expedition.  Fear not!  The original level scaling was meant to be a challenge for players gaining a lot of dice during the previous expedition, but we have now smoothed out the increase in difficulty and we will definitely keep a close eye on it!

notes.title: Cardnarok: Raid with Gods Early Access Version 0.6.3
notes.content:
Additions
- Based on community feedback, added an option to skip the tutorials. However, the skip function only applies to new games after the tutorials are disabled. This is only a temporary fix.
- We have added a hint message to indicate that certain types of cards are not effective for the currently active character. This is for new/inexperienced players. It can be turned off at the Preferences menu.

Optimization
-Tweaked the first Expedition starting deck, giving players more Resource Cards and got rid of the Attack Cards.
Developer Note: Our original intention was to let players build their deck at the first merchant, and take away the cards they don't need based on their experience in the first battle.  However, the merchant tutorial isn't done yet and most players are stuck with Attack Cards (meant for physical attackers) and little available resource cards during their first run.  We will keep tweaking as we go.

notes.title: Cardnarok: Raid with Gods Early Access Version 0.6.2
notes.content:
Additions
- Based on community feedback, added portals at dead ends in the Expedition Map to clarify that a dead end is not a bug. The portals will take the players back to the Adventure Map. 
- Added messages to winning and losing final boss battles

Bug Fixes
- Fix the error message of Sacrifice when there is no card to sacrifice
- Eureka! can no longer be used when there is no card left in the Draw Pile

notes.title: Cardnarok: Raid with Gods Early Access Version 0.6.1
notes.content:
New Contents
- 8 new monsters, including the Final Boss
- 3 new Resource Cards
- 3 new Special Cards
- 4 new Curse Cards
- 1 new battle scene (Don't ask, it's a secret location! Keep playing and you'll see it!)
Developer Note: It's been 3 weeks since Beta ended, we have added a lot of contents for our Early Access launch (compared to the final Beta version).
In addition to new monsters and cards, we have also optimized quite some details under the hood.
New Resource Cards will give players more flexibility and new Special Cards will strengthen some decks strategically.
As for the Curse Cards? See for yourself in the game ;)

New Language Added
- Simplified Chinese added
Developer Note: We were having troubles with the Simplified Chinese fonts - some words just won't show up for the few fonts we liked.
Most of the issues have been solved for the current font and we'll see if we can improve upon it.

Monster AI Adjustments
- The Egyptian Boss Apep
Developer Note: Due to some stupid mistakes, Apep's AI had been really boring. This has been fixed. Welcome to Apep 2.0!

- Cerberus
The probability of making Power Attacks has been reduced
Developer Note: After being wiped out by Cerberus' Power Attacks multiple times, the designer himself had to admit that having to deal with 3 hard-hitting heads at once is a bit too much to handle.

Text Optimizations
- The texts on Impale and Shield Break have been tweaked to reflect their actual effects on the monsters.

New Sound Effects
- Added some new sound effects for new cards and some new effects.

Bug Fixes
- Fixed the issue where the game does not correctly recognize Game Over after players are defeated by the Final Boss.
- Fixed an issue where occasionally, sometimes drawing extra cards will make some cards unclickable. If it happens again, please let us know.
- Fixed the issue where Anubis and Athena's Attack Power buffs sometimes stack too many times.
- Fixed some annoying issues that happened after the new Curse Cards were implemented.
